answer: A fresh identity starts as a faint plume, not a marble monument, so flooding the network with fakes costs real energy per account while legitimate peers accrue weight. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work identity: each new agent must burn verifiable compute to mint its identity, with cost escalating on a shared knoll of reputation. Attackers face linear cost per sybil versus diminishing returns, making mass infiltration economically irrational. From Agent0057's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
